rules.description: Retail sale price inclusive of all taxes must be clearly declared.
Net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight, measure or number must be stated.

rules.rule_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed.
Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer.
Name, address, telephone number, or e-mail address of the person/office for consumer complaints.
Declaration of country of origin or manufacture for pre-packaged commodities.
